name: Malaysia Marathon 2026
short_description: A full marathon with 21.1 km, 10 km and 5 km races, run on 30 August 2026 in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia; the longer races started at Pavilion Bukit Bintang and all races finished at KLCC.
ai_summary: Malaysia Marathon 2026, the first edition, was run in the early hours of Sunday 30 August 2026 in Kuala Lumpur, organised by Malaysia Marathon with SCORE Experience. It offered 42.195 km, 21.1 km, 10 km and 5 km races. The marathon, half marathon and 10 km started at Pavilion Bukit Bintang and finished at KLCC; the 5 km fun run was held around KLCC.

core_facts.venue: Start Pavilion Bukit Bintang, finish KLCC

pros: Night start: the marathon went off at 12.30am, the half at 2am
Finish at KLCC after a start at Pavilion, with a 330 g medal for all four distances
Course the organiser says is World Athletics and AIMS certified
cons: Hilly middle section on the AKLEH and SUKE elevated highways
Warm at night: 30°C at midnight and 27°C at 8am in 2026
Late-August date in the haze season; air quality was unhealthy on race morning in 2026
Slots and bibs could be transferred only through the organiser's app, for RM50, before a mid-August deadline
research_highlights: The 2026 edition was a multi-distance event (5K, 10K, 21K, 42K) on Sunday 30 August 2026; the 42K, 21K and 10K started at Pavilion KL, and all categories finished at KLCC.

The 10KM route starts at Pavilion and finishes at KLCC, passing Dataran Merdeka and other city landmarks, while the 5KM loops around KLCC itself, according to the organiser's official course description.
The marathon started at 12.30am, the half marathon at 2am, the 10K at 3.30am and the 5K at 7.30am, and the organiser said about 95% of the route used major highways, including AKLEH and SUKE.
The event's finisher medal for 2026 is themed around Malaysia's 69th Independence Day, features the emblem of Tunku Abdul Rahman, and weighs 330 grams (made from recycled zinc), per the organiser.
Kuala Lumpur races in general are run in a hot, humid tropical climate, which other Klang Valley marathon guides flag as a real physical test requiring heat preparation.

faqs.question: What distances are offered at the Malaysia Marathon 2026?
faqs.answer: Malaysia Marathon 2026 offered four races: a 42.195 km marathon, a 21.1 km half marathon, a 10 km and a 5 km fun run. The marathon had a cut-off of seven and a half hours. The organiser said its course was a certified measured course by World Athletics and AIMS.

faqs.question: When was the Malaysia Marathon 2026?
faqs.answer: Malaysia Marathon 2026 was run in the early hours of Sunday 30 August 2026, the eve of Malaysia's 69th National Day. The marathon started at 12.30am, the half marathon at 2am, the 10 km at 3.30am and the 5 km fun run at 7.30am.

faqs.question: Where does the race start and finish?
faqs.answer: The marathon, half marathon and 10 km started at Pavilion on Jalan Bukit Bintang and finished at KLCC; the 5 km fun run was held around KLCC. The routes used Jalan Sultan Ismail, Jalan Raja Chulan and Jalan Tuanku Abdul Rahman in the city centre before the marathon and half marathon went onto the AKLEH elevated highway.
